items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3hrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ae8bf56bdf7df2a9ddef232b67ef1762d8b05535/logo_200x200.png) This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England. items.name: Happy Valley Fall PA 2024

venue.name: [HUB-Robeson Center](https://studentaffairs.psu.edu/hub)
venue.details: Heritage Hall, first floor of the HUB

items.information: ## NOTE: This competition will be held on a Sunday! ## PSU students must leave their PSU email as a comment on their registration to qualify for the discounted registration fee of $10. The full registration fee ($25) must be paid, and then qualifying registrations will receive the refund. ## Competitors may bring at most one guest. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue. ## In accordance with University policy all competitors 17 years of age and younger MUST have their legal guardian accompanying them to this competition. ## All proceeds from the event will be going to the PSU Rubik's Cube Club. * Competitors may bring at most one guest. * Heritage Hall is located on the first floor of the HUB. This is NOT the same room as Happy Valley Spring 2024. To easily get to Heritage Hall inside the HUB-Robeson Center, you may take any of the elevators on the food court level up to the first floor **except for the elevator next to the Panda Express/Sbarro shops**. From there, Heritage Hall should be just within range to your left or right. * The organizing team strongly recommends receiving a COVID-19 vaccination before competing. For information on, and finding vaccines near you, please use [this website](https://www.vaccines.gov/)! * If you have symptoms related to COVID-19 such as cough, fever, shortness of breath, etc. do not attend this competition. * If you have had a positive COVID-19 test or prolonged exposure to someone with the virus within 14 days prior to the competition, do not attend. * By registering for this competition, you agree that you understand all the information presented in this tab, will abide by all the COVID-19 restrictions placed on this competition, and acknowledge the risk of contracting COVID-19 or any other disease in attending an event of this scale.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc2MDIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--4eac296410f623b9d230decb83866e56d4ea0296/LIGA%20SLP%20ROJO.png) # **ESPAÑOL** Te invitamos a una serie de mini competencias que se llevarán a cabo en San Luis Potosí, totalmente gratuitas. Estas competencias están diseñadas para ofrecer a los participantes una experiencia divertida y relajada, ideal tanto para principiantes como para aquellos que quieran mejorar sus habilidades. ¡No pierdas la oportunidad de unirte y disfrutar de esta emocionante serie de eventos!. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. # **ENGLISH** We invite you to a series of mini competitions that will take place in San Luis Potosí, completely free of charge. These competitions are designed to offer participants a fun and relaxed experience, ideal for beginners as well as those who want to improve their skills. Don’t miss the chance to join and enjoy this exciting series of events! This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) prior to competition.
